briefdescription.para: Handles overrun, framing, parity, and break receive error interrupts.

detaileddescription.para: This interrupt occurs whenever a number of bytes have been present in the RX FIFO and the receive data line has been idle for at least 4 or more character times (the timeout is set using XUartPs_SetRecvTimeout()).
It does not do any processing except to call the application handler to indicate a modem event.

briefdescription.para: Receives the previously specified buffer from the instance variables.

detaileddescription.para: This is an internal function that may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.
Attempts to receive a specified number of bytes from the device and store them into the specified buffer. Works for either polled or interrupt driven modes. This function is non-blocking.

In polled mode, this function only receives as much data as in the RX FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive the entire buffer. Polled mode is the default mode for the driver.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the receiving. If not the entire buffer has been received, the interrupt handler continues until the entire buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of the receiving or error conditions.

briefdescription.para: Sends the previously specified buffer from the instance variables.

detaileddescription.para: This is an internal function for the XUartPs driver that may be called from a shell function that sets up the buffer or from an interrupt handler.
Sends the specified buffer in either polled or interrupt driven modes. This function is non-blocking.
In polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the TX FIFO can buffer. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the sending of the buffer. If not the entire buffer has been sent, then the interrupt handler continues the sending until the entire buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.
